<!-- Source page: C2FmZQ -->

[c2FmZQ](https://github.com/c2FmZQ/c2FmZQ/) is an web application that can securely encrypt, store, and share files, including but not limited to pictures and videos.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-c2fmzq).
